name: Amelie Maçon
source:
The Childhood Friend, a friendly and pretty standard heroine-type who seems very accommodating.

Amelie is one of three playable protagonists in Entropic Float. She gives off a fairly typical vibe, but players will quickly come to understand that her 'girl next door' persona is riddled with holes.
